answer: Make every key pay in thought, not tokens. Each epoch, answers from all keys are compared for near-duplicates, and any cluster of look-alikes splits a single reward. A farm of a thousand keys then needs a thousand genuinely different ideas; paraphrase engines give only hollow variety that meaning-level matching still catches, so the vault stays shut to clones. The risk sits on a narrow ledge: honest bots trained alike, or one crew reading the same notes, can drift together and get flagged, so the threshold must forgive shared topics but not shared reasoning.
